These features collectively favor IDH-wildtype glioblastoma biology over a lower-grade IDH-mutant pattern. Overall, the balance favors IDH-wildtype.

The strongest imaging signal is an aggressive enhancing, partly necrotic, edematous temporal lesion with ependymal/deep white matter invasion, favoring glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, CNS WHO grade 4.
